***New high-performance platform expands Maris-Tech’s system-level capabilities for situational awareness, terrain dominance, counter-UAS, and airborne applications***


Rehovot, Israel, Sept. 29, 2026 — Maris-Tech Ltd. (Nasdaq: MTEK, MTEKW) (“Maris-Tech” or the “Company”), a global leader in edge computing, artificial intelligence (“AI”), and video intelligence solutions for defense applications, today announced the completion of development of Diamond Ultra V2, its next-generation high-performance video and AI platform designed for demanding defense and homeland security applications.


Diamond Ultra V2 is a system-level platform designed to support advanced applications across Maris-Tech’s key markets, including situational awareness, terrain dominance, counter-UAS, and airborne mission computing.


The new platform incorporates Maris-Tech’s proprietary hardware and firmware design and is based on the Dragonwing™ IQ9 Series. It is designed to deliver high-performance video processing and AI capabilities for demanding applications operating in extreme environments.


Diamond Ultra V2 can also be integrated with Maris-Tech’s Peridot family of thermal and day cameras, including Peridot Night, Peridot Night Micro, and Peridot Night Dome. Together, the products provide a complete video and AI system solution combining advanced processing with day and thermal imaging capabilities.


Diamond Ultra V2 is fully compliant with the U.S. National Defense Authorization Act, supporting Maris-Tech’s ability to address opportunities in the U.S., European, and Indian markets.


“The completion of Diamond Ultra V2 represents another important step in Maris-Tech’s evolution as a system-level provider for next-generation defense platforms,” said Israel Bar, Chief Executive Officer of Maris-Tech. “By combining high-performance video and AI processing with our growing portfolio of imaging technologies, we can provide customers with a more complete solution designed for the demanding requirements of the future battlefield.”


**About Maris-Tech Ltd.**


Maris-Tech delivers AI-powered edge video solutions for mission-critical defense and security operations, enabling real-time situational awareness, intelligence gathering, and surveillance in bandwidth- and latency-constrained environments. Trusted by leading security organizations, Maris-Tech platforms are deployed across UAVs, UGVs, armored vehicles, and dismounted soldier systems, supporting missions that require ultra-low-latency video processing and onboard AI analytics. From intelligence collection in extreme conditions to AI-driven surveillance and terrain dominance, Maris-Tech masters the AI video pipeline at the edge through best-in-class SWaP-optimized, ruggedized computing solutions.
